about.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

name: v1.4.205
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️ Please note: It usually takes 48–72 hours for a landed PR to be released (except P0+ fixes). We have many more exciting PRs and features coming in later versions! ## The short version **Agents & chat:** Native chat adds a message rail for jumping between your prompts, keeps a resumed transcript pinned to its end, holds a detached reader in place as messages grow, and cancels pending prompts precisely. OMP conversations resume from session history under their saved names, agent-status ingress moves behind a single admission point, and a timed-out hook now actually terminates its process tree. **Workspaces, editor & source control:** A failed archive hook blocks worktree removal instead of deleting anyway, and worktree registrations survive prunable git-file states. Stage, unstage and discard failures surface with retry, automations repair cron step expansion and stop tick latency counting against the missed-run grace, code blocks gain a copy button, and Tiptap moves up behind Markdown compatibility guards. **Terminal & remote:** Terminal renames survive pane hydration, handles persist across PTY incarnation rotation, and PTY child-process checks preserve an unverifiable verdict instead of guessing. Relay failures become diagnosable by acquisition versus execution phase, and streamed remote records are bounded. **Performance:** Codex usage scans do far less work — attribution resolved once per scan, and grown rollouts resumed at the last parsed byte — which takes a large cold scan from minutes to under a minute. They still run on the main process; the worker-thread move lands in a later release. --- ## Product experience ### Workspaces, tabs & editor *Safer worktree removal, clearer failure reporting, and a Tiptap upgrade with Markdown compatibility guards.* * Add copy button to code blocks by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20357 * fix(composer): clarify failed attachment drops by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20704 * Distinguish pane load failures from empty states by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20735 * fix(worktrees): safely remove prunable git-file registrations by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20617 * fix(worktrees): preserve unverifiable disk witness by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20713 * fix(worktree): block removal when the archive hook fails by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20153 * fix(automations): repair cron step expansion and day restriction [HELD — semantic half] by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20202 * fix(automations): stop tick latency counting against the missed-run grace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20819 * Improve microphone permission errors and drop failure reporting by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20801 * Report clipboard and composer drop failures by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20795 * fix(deps): migrate Tiptap security updates with Markdown compatibility guards by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19376 * feat(design-system): gate renderer UI with @shadcn/lint by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20731 * fix(ui): contain idle caret paint so agent panes stop burning CPU by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/10554 ### Source control *Staging failures are recoverable and Git spawn errors say what actually went wrong.* * Surface stage, unstage and discard failures with retry capability by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20423 * fix(source-control): prevent text wrapping in section headers and action buttons by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20046 * fix(git): distinguish binary absence from missing cwd on spawn ENOENT by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20798 ## Agents & workflow ### Agent reliability & native chat *Chat navigation and transcript positioning improve, and agent state is reported through one ingress point.* * fix(native-chat): bound a dispatch reason before it reaches the journal row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20654 * fix(native-chat): keep a resumed transcript pinned to its end by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20651 * fix(codex): settle a structured send on admission, and stop minting a colliding identity by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20138 * fix(omp): preserve status after terminal title owner rewrite by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20610 * fix(agents): find OMP by its full project name by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20647 * fix(omp): preserve saved conversation names in session history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20636 * fix(agent-session): honour the backup-recovery fence floor on surface release by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20708 * fix(hooks): actually terminate a timed-out hook's process tree by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20576 * fix(native-chat): cancel pending prompts precisely by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20601 * fix: resume OMP child conversations from session history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20629 * fix(ai-vault): expand nested OMP session history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20663 * fix(native-chat): let a reader park just above the latest message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20709 * fix(native-chat): preserve detached transcript position during growth by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20710 * feat(native-chat): add a message rail for jumping between your prompts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20719 * refactor(agent-status): isolate legacy status ingress behind one admission point by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20716 * fix(runtime): apply the tui-idle evidence ranking to mailbox delivery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20578 * fix(orchestration): require the registered pane key to prove structured worker identity by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20664 ### Terminal *Renames, handles and PTY verdicts survive rotation, hydration and uncertainty.* * fix(omp): preserve zsh startup with global aliases by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20621 * fix(terminal): retain renames before renderer pane hydration by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20619 * fix: keep OMP terminals when folder workspaces become Git repos by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20653 * Fix PTY child process verdict to preserve unverifiable state by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20729 * fix(runtime): preserve terminal handles across PTY incarnation rotation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20779 * fix(pty): preserve child-process inspection uncertainty by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20756 ### Mobile *Mobile continues its typed-RPC migration.* * Bump mobile app.json to 0.0.50 by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20661 * refactor(mobile): migrate the small domains onto RpcOperation (step 4) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20705 ### Relay & cloud *Relay failures are diagnosable by phase, and streamed remote records are bounded.* * fix(ai-vault): bound streamed remote JSONL records by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20700 * feat(runtime): stream file uploads instead of buffering whole files by @mmarabel in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16106 * Expose preloaded PostgreSQL statement statistics for relay diagnostics by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20712 * Diagnose relay PostgreSQL failures by acquisition versus execution phase by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20749 * fix(relay): open the real null device when detaching Windows stdio by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20808 ## Quality & delivery *Nothing here changes what you see — it changes how smoothly Orca behaves under real workloads. Expanded below if you want the detail.*
Performance improvements *Targeted optimizations remove repeated work from the Codex, OpenCode and Claude usage scanners and from no-op store updates. These reduce the cost of a scan; they do not yet move it off the main process.* Highlights include resolving each cwd's worktree once per scan rather than per event, resuming grown Codex rollouts at the last parsed byte behind a boundary digest and inode check, and preserving state identity across no-op updater paths so selectors stop re-running. * fix(store): stop two no-op writes from re-running every selector in the app by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20641 * fix(store): preserve state identity across no-op updater paths by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20703 * perf(usage): resolve each cwd's worktree once per scan by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21130 * perf(codex-usage): resume rollout scans at the last parsed byte by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21102
Reliability, tests & delivery * fix(ci): stop hourly versions dropping below a tagged or already-shipped build by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20699 * test: add a verified OMP native-chat mock scenario by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20655 * test(mobile): pin each RPC golden to the recorder inputs that can reach it, not the whole directory by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20662 * ci: keep the baseline Git build off the compatibility matrix lanes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20733 * fix(ci): stop defining pilot mutant tests inside a conditional by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20755 * test(native-chat): split the windowing test harness out of the suite by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20773 * chore(lint): add anti-slop oxlint plugin (pinned, all rules off) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20726 * chore(lint): enable anti-slop no-reduce-accumulator-copy and no-widen-then-assert by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20780 * fix(lint): keep root postinstall as the sole Electron binary install owner by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20788 * test(package): let the postinstall contract allow unrelated chained steps by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20787 * fix(lint): enable anti-slop/no-unknown-type-aliases by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20784 * refactor(lint): enable anti-slop/no-reflect-apply by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20782 * fix(lint): enable anti-slop/no-module-mocking by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20783 * test(package): reject an Electron install takeover by exact command by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20799 * fix(lint): enable anti-slop/no-reflect-get by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20786 * fix(lint): enable anti-slop/no-object-parameters by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20781 * fix(lint): enable anti-slop/no-shape-in-symbol-names by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20785 * fix(git): avoid Windows tree kills after the command has exited by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20606 * build(release): compile the Windows relay process-table addon by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20809
